The turns that matter shouldn't be left to a cheap model."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Before every turn of a top-level agent, a small **LLM Judge** (running on your Fast-tier model chain"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" by default — see `routing.judge.mode`) classifies the user's message as `fast` (routine) or `smart`"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" (consequential). The chosen tier then drives the whole turn — thinking, tool calls, code edits — th"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"rough the harness's own `agent/request` pipeline. The Judge only classifies; it never does the work."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Expected-cost routing** — the turn runs Smart iff `pSmart ≥ θ`, with `θ = 1/reworkPenalty`: the "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"bar is price-independent, so the one knob is how badly a wrong downgrade hurts. Upgrades are instant"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"; coming back down needs `downgradeMemory` **consecutive** decisive `fast` turns. An unsure verdict "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"is a **hold** — the router keeps its position instead of guessing.
- **Pluggable Judge** — the verdi"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"ct comes from the Fast chain by default; `routing.judge.mode` can point it at a dedicated Judge chai"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"n (`custom`) or at a **decision model** (`decision` — the TypeSafe Jev / System One class, Beta), wh"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"ich answers with a typed choice and a probability instead of prose, so there is no reply-parsing ste"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"p and no malformed-reply failure class. Measured against the live endpoint on this deployment: corre"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"ct, **1.4–5.7 s per verdict** (the 15 s floor is real — the 5 s default would have aborted it), and "},{"id":"p10s10","text":"the tier came back fully decided on 4 of 4 prompts, so treat it as a **hard classifier** rather than"},{"id":"p10s11","text":" a graded one; only the orchestration signal is graded (0.10–0.83). Every configured source falls ba"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"ck to the Fast chain when it is unusable, and **with no Judge at all the router stops routing**: the"},{"id":"p10s13","text":" turn runs on your own selected model, orchestration is cleared, and the session is told once.
- **C"},{"id":"p10s14","text":"ache-aware routing** — when Fast and Smart share a provider, the decision bar is divided by `sameFam"},{"id":"p10s15","text":"ilyPenalty` (default 1.5) and downgrades are held off while the prompt cache is warm, so switching t"},{"id":"p10s16","text":"o a cheaper model never costs more than staying put.
- **Runtime failover** — 429 / 402 / 5xx / quot"},{"id":"p10s17","text":"a / usage-limit / unsupported-model failures put the model into exponential-backoff cooldown (1m → 4"},{"id":"p10s18","text":"m → 16m → 1h04m → 4h16m → 6h cap; client-side limits start at 16m) and re-resolve the same tier to t"},{"id":"p10s19","text":"he next healthy model — same-turn retry, never cross-tier.
